svg.title: Current sampling rates
svg.desc: Animated lanes show how often each section runs over a 30 second window: the sampler thread tick at 5 Hz, resource samples every 2 s, memory samples every 30 s, collector commits every 0.5 s, and dashboard polls every 1 to 15 s.

g.text: Defaults. One 30 s window loops; each tick lights up when the playhead passes it. The dot on the left blinks in real time.
Thread ticks are the base clock. Resource and memory samples ride on a thread tick, after the thread sample, and never run more often than it.
The sampler lowers its rate when it uses more than 1% of one core (minimum 0.2 Hz). The local sampler.toml may set other values.
